culture.text: The Papendrecht unit, GKN Fokker Elmo, designs, makes and supports aircraft wiring systems (EWIS) for civil, defence and engine makers.
It calls itself an innovative, international workplace with a long history in aircraft building, part of a group with over 16,000 staff at 32 manufacturing sites.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor, so check sponsorship before applying if you need a work permit.

growth.text: The group had about 16,000 staff and £3.35 billion revenue in 2023.
It is expanding plants abroad, including a $16 million US plant investment and a new wiring facility in India.

worth_knowing.text: A chemical tank crisis at its Garden Grove, California plant led to evacuations and a $100 million claims fund for affected residents.
Orange County voted to sue the company over the tank crisis; a probe ended without criminal charges.
